title: Signature Verification
description: The signature must equal the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact `raw_body` bytes, keyed with the UTF-8 `secret`. Any discrepancy (missing, empty, incorrect secret, corrupted/flipped byte, uppercase hex, non-ASCII characters, or signature computed over re-serialized JSON): return status `"rejected"`, commit no database state change, and raise no exception.
